- No description of the method itself (what is the method?)
- No description of the results beyond the accuracy numbers
- No mention of the ablation study results
- No comparison to prior work
- No discussion of significance/interpretation

The abstract is essentially just a one-sentence claim with no supporting detail. While it has some concrete numbers (78.2% to 82.5%), the abstract lacks substance because:
1. It doesn't explain what the method is
2. It doesn't explain the problem being solved
3. It doesn't describe the ablation study results
4. It's extremely terse

This is a low-quality abstract. The expectation score should be low, maybe around 0.2-0.3.
